verdict.rationale: Sunbiz is a government business-entity filing and records portal for online articles, annual reports and status lookups. It is not an AI agent or tool-using host, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence suggests it ships any agent or tool-consumption capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
